verdict.rationale: Stable says the virtual address can be used "with the IRS, the state, vendors, and more." That is a thin, positive-only statement of where the address works. It does not name banks or payment processors and never says where the address will not be accepted. The USPS Form 1583 onboarding shows a compliant CMRA setup but is not described as a proof-of-address document for financial institutions. Missing for 10: any proof-of-address document or certificate for banks and payment processors, explicit statements on bank and processor acceptance, a stated list of where the address does not work, and independent corroboration of acceptance.
